points.point: Is Blotato missing views (YouTube 4,100 vs Blotato 3,200)?
points.sentence: Blotato and the YouTube watch page count views differently, so the two numbers never match exactly.

points.point: Why the YouTube count is higher than Blotato's
points.sentence: The watch page count updates in near real time and includes views YouTube has not validated yet. Blotato's count comes from the YouTube Analytics API, which reports only finalized views.

verdict.reason: The youtube-views-lower entry directly explains why Blotato's YouTube view count is lower than the YouTube watch page count.
